shortDescription: Information module for Feature Templates Wireless Summary

options.name: designName
options.description: DesignName query parameter. Feature template design name.

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. The number of records to show for this page. Default is 25 if not specified. Maximum allowed limit is 25.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. The first record to show for this page. The first record is numbered 1.

options.name: systemTemplate
options.description: SystemTemplate query parameter. If 'True', it signifies a system-generated template; if 'False', it denotes a user-modifiable template.

options.name: type
options.description: Type query parameter. Feature template name. Allowed values EVENT_DRIVEN_RRM_CONFIGURATION, DOT11AX_CONFIGURATION, AAA_RADIUS_ATTRIBUTES_CONFIGURATION, ADVANCED_SSID_CONFIGURATION, RRM_FRA_CONFIGURATION, CLEANAIR_CONFIGURATION, DOT11BE_STATUS_CONFIGURATION, FLEX_CONFIGURATION, MULTICAST_CONFIGURATION, RRM_GENERAL_CONFIGURATION.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
